At the conclusion of its July meeting, the Federal Reserve kept its key interest rate at the target range of 3.5% to 3.75%.

However, three members of the policymaking FOMC dissented with the move, and wanted to hike.

Read more about the Fed's decision from CNBC's Jeff Cox here.
